$comment: Settings that differ per environment, and the names of secrets whose values live in .env (never here).
$example: values: { "apiBaseUrl": { "type": "url", "description": "Backend API.", "development": "http://localhost:8080", "staging": "https://staging.example.com", "production": "https://api.example.com" } }. Types: string, url, boolean, int. secrets: { "mapsApiKey": { "type": "string", "description": "Maps SDK key" } }.

freeDeliveryThreshold.description: Item total, in rupees, at or above which delivery is free.

deliveryFee.description: Delivery fee, in rupees, below the free-delivery threshold.
